cohort: 292 preterm newborns (113 with NEC and 179 matched controls)
finding: Early-onset infection was identified as a significant risk factor for NEC in preterm newborns, while late-onset feeding and initial continuous enteral feeding were associated with increased NEC severity.
mod_finding: This case-controlled study matched preterm infants with and without necrotizing enterocolitis based on gestational age, date of birth, and mode of delivery, finding that mode of delivery was not significantly associated with NEC.
